line: Text someone good morning and mean it.
paragraph: A young construction worker in southern Brazil had just withdrawn his whole monthly salary from the bank. He lost the wad of cash on the ground in a public plaza, with no one around looking for it. A man named Pedro Moro found it. He did not know it was another person's entire pay, money needed for his daughter. Pedro spent twelve days returning the cash to the worker he had never met. Good morning meant something again.
